A Lynel-made bow crafted from rough metal. True to the vicious nature of Lynel weaponry. It fires a spread of multiple arrows at once. Ideal for taking down quick-moving targets.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|'''Lynel Bow'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 10 |durability = 30 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lynel Bow}} Lynel Bows are [[Bow]]s used by regular [[Lynel]]s, particularly in the [[Gerudo Highlands]] and [[Lanayru Great Spring]]. They become scarce as Lynels tier up. However, in [[Master Mode]], [[Blue-Maned Lynel]]s will use them instead, but they will still disappear with Blue-Maned Lynels. The only exception is the Lynel on [[Ploymus Mountain]], which is always a regular Lynel. Therefore, it may become the only source of Lynel Bows in the world as the game goes on. Lynels make these Bows from rough metal. They can fire multiple [[Arrow]]s at a time, most commonly three, but occasionally one can be found that fires five Arrows at once. Lynel Bows are part of the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s created and utilized by Lynels.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} They are known to reflect the vicious nature of Lynel Gear and are ideal for taking down fast-moving targets. Being made of metal, Lynel Bows conduct [[Electricity]] and will attract [[Lightning]] if equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They will also sink if dropped in water, but can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, they do not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_009" |Life = 30 |Power = 10 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 18 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = true |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = true |LeadShotNum = 3 |LeadShotAng = 3 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Lynel Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bow * Lynel Gear * Mighty Lynel Bow * Savage Lynel Bow }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bows, Lynel Gear, Weapons |items= BotW, TotK }}
